periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward diagonal orientation toward the medial plane relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a high eccentricity, where the length significantly exceeds the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering and elongation towards the muzzle.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap between the ears, approximately 1.5 to 2 times the horizontal width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and smoothly rounded curvature at the apex boundary.
